Class AuthenticationApplicationService

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.application.AuthenticationApplicationService
@ApplicationScoped public class AuthenticationApplicationService extends Object
Signs analysts in and out. Two ways in, one result: a session token for the browser's cookie. A password sign-in checks the stored hash; a Microsoft sign-in (completed elsewhere by the OpenID Connect flow) finds or creates the account for the Microsoft identity and remembers the user's Graph tokens. Failed password attempts are counted per email, and too many in a row lock that email out for a while.
